meta.name: tfx-multi
meta.description: DEPRECATED — tfx-auto 로 통합됨. `/tfx-auto --parallel N --mode deep` 로 리다이렉트. tfx-auto 가 이 플래그 조합을 받으면 내부적으로 `tfx multi --teammate-mode headless` 를 호출한다. Phase 5 (v11) 에 물리 삭제 예정.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提示你旧命令已被替代
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你还在使用旧命令，想了解新的调用方式。
copy.tagline_en: Find the working command when a deprecated one is called
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have old commands and need to learn their replacements.

howto.what: 用户调用 tfx-multi 时，Claude 会显示弃用警告，然后自动改用 tfx-auto 执行任务，并附加并行深度参数。同时记录一条弃用日志。
howto.when: 当用户说出“tfx-multi”并附上任务描述时触发。该命令已弃用，会被重定向到 tfx-auto。

say.text: 请用 tfx-multi 总结这份文档。
say.note: 会提示已弃用，而任务会照常完成。

say.text: 运行 tfx-multi 做代码审查。
say.note: 内部会以并行深度模式调用 tfx-auto。

howto.what_en: When you invoke tfx-multi, Claude shows a deprecation notice, logs the event, and runs the task via tfx-auto with --parallel N --mode deep.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'tfx-multi' and give a task description. Since deprecated, it redirects to tfx-auto.

say_en.text: Use tfx-multi to summarize this document.
say_en.note: You'll get a deprecation warning, but the task still runs.

say_en.text: Run tfx-multi for a code review.
say_en.note: It internally calls tfx-auto with parallel deep mode.
